name: Ep12 - Proposal Sender (sell to local businesses)

parameters.formDescription: Fill this in during the first call. The proposal prices itself and goes out before you hang up.

values.fieldLabel: Task they do by hand every day
What an hour of their time costs ($)

assignments.name: task
assignments.value: ={{ $json['Task they do by hand every day'] }}

assignments.name: cost_month
assignments.value: ={{ Math.round(Number($json['Minutes a day it takes']) * 21 / 60 * Number($json['What an hour of their time costs ($)'])) }}

assignments.name: setup_fee
assignments.value: ={{ Math.max(500, Math.round(Number($json['Minutes a day it takes']) * 21 / 60 * Number($json['What an hour of their time costs ($)']) / 50) * 50) }}

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.business }}: getting {{ $json.hours_month }} hours a month back
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $json.owner }},

Good talking just now. Here is what we covered, in writing.

The job: {{ $json.task }}
Right now that is about {{ $json.hours_month }} hours a month of your time, roughly ${{ $json.cost_month }} a month at what an hour of your time costs.

What I will build: one automation that does it for you, running inside a week, shown working on your real customers before you pay the second half.

Setup: ${{ $json.setup_fee }}, half now, half when it runs.
After month one: ${{ $json.retainer }} a month to host it, watch it, and fix it when something changes.

If that works, reply yes and I will send the deposit link. If not, reply with what would.

Thanks,
OwnerAutomate Demo

parameters.completionMessage: =Setup ${{ $('Price It').item.json.setup_fee }}, then ${{ $('Price It').item.json.retainer }} a month. Follow up in 2 days if no reply.
